name: library-documentation
description: The library documentation retrieval source for code-rag-bench, contains all documentation for Python libraries available on devdocs.io.
evaluation_method: retrieval metrics (MRR, Recall@k) and exact_match for extracted snippets/answers
reputation: Used as a documentation corpus in the Code-RAG project and hosted on Hugging Face; commonly used as a retrieval source but not a standardized leaderboard benchmark.
